issue.description:
docs/research/rackspace-spot-api.md records that autoscaled pools must not carry a fixed desired count (the upstream cluster-autoscaler owns it), yet the intent API's only operation is 'set node count' via PATCH. For an autoscaled pool it is unspecified whether warden patches desired (documented as invalid/fought by the autoscaler), adjusts autoscaling.minNodes/maxNodes, or refuses the request. Decide and implement one behavior, document it in docs/notes/invariant-policy.md and the README API table, and cover it in policy tests. Land after warden-9abf320c confirms the live autoscaling field names — related but distinct: that bead verifies field names, this one defines the scale-path behavior.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.notes:
Decided and implemented SCALE-BY-CEILING semantics for autoscaled pools: 'scale to N' patches spec.autoscaling.maxNodes only — never desired (the upstream cluster-autoscaler owns it; a fixed desired is documented invalid in docs/research/rackspace-spot-api.md and would be fought) and never minNodes. NEW policy guard in EvaluateScale: count < autoscaling.minNodes is DENIED fail-closed (would invert the window; warden will not co-adjust the floor — that is a pool re-shape, out-of-band). Allow reason for autoscaled targets now names maxNodes for audit fidelity. Scale-to-zero on an autoscaled pool with minNodes=0 remains allowed (pause, not delete).

Landed after warden-9abf320c (closed): field names confirmed camelCase minNodes/maxNodes.

Changes (commit a7bebb8, pushed to origin/main):
- internal/policy/policy.go: minNodes guard + differentiated allow reason
- internal/policy/policy_test.go: 4 new tests (scales-by-ceiling, deny-below-minNodes, scale-to-zero vs nonzero floor, org-cap counts new ceiling) — package 14/14 green
- internal/spot/client.go: ScaleNodePool comment states the decided semantics (also fixed stale 'desiredCount' name in it)
- docs/notes/invariant-policy.md: envelope row + 'Scale semantics' section + minNodes/toggle added to impossible-by-construction
- README.md: 'What it enforces' bullet + scale-semantics note under the API table
- docs/plan/plan.md: invariant 5 + open question resolved for the scale-path half

Verification: gofmt clean on changed files, go vet clean, go test: policy/spot PASS. PRE-EXISTING failures unrelated to this bead (verified at HEAD via stash before my changes): internal/server TestHexSHA (stale hardcoded digest) + TestScaleRequestParsing/missing_count_field, internal/config empty-AllowedServerClasses case. Left as-is — separate defects, not scale-path behavior.

issue.description:
The documented org ceiling is evaluated read-before-write: the server lists pools, policy sums Σ UpperBound(other pools) against the requested count, then warden patches Spot. Two concurrent scale requests can both pass against the same snapshot and both apply, leaving the summed upper bounds above the org ceiling — the one guarantee warden exists to enforce. Close the window: serialize scale handling (per-instance mutex/single-flight) and/or use the Spot CRD's resourceVersion as an optimistic concurrency check on the patch (re-read + compare, deny or retry on conflict). Add a test proving N concurrent allowed requests can never push the total past MAX_TOTAL_NODES, and record the chosen mechanism in docs/notes/invariant-policy.md.

---
Priority: P1
Created by: weave strand
